task.title: Run import, review, export, and compliance metadata handoff
task.shortdesc: Connect an external review or compliance product to BPM import and export APIs without treating BPM metadata as Firefox deployment content.

prereq.p: Set $BPM_BASE_URL and prepare a reviewed Firefox policies.json source document plus external compliance metadata such as scanner, ticket, reviewer, and decision.

context.p: This workflow uses API-FF-001, API-PROFILE-003, API-VAL-001, and API-FF-002. BPM stores opaque compliance metadata on the profile, but exported Firefox JSON contains only deployable policies.

step.cmd: Import the reviewed source document into a BPM profile.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/import/firefox/policies.json with JSON {"name":"reviewed-corp-baseline","schema_version":"release-153","compliance":{"scanner":"external-control","ticket":"SEC-42"},"document":{"policies":{"DisableTelemetry":true}}}. Response example: 201 ProfileRead.

step.cmd: Read back the created profile and separate BPM fields from external evidence.

info.p: Request example: GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/42. Response example: 200 ProfileRead with revision, flags, and opaque compliance. Error examples: 404 or 422.

step.cmd: Review the normalized policy set before export.

info.p: The reviewer checks imported keys, schema channel, source document hash, compliance metadata, and any BPM normalization warnings. BPM does not certify the external scanner result or Firefox runtime enforcement.

step.cmd: Validate the deployment document that will be exported.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-153 with JSON {"document":{"policies":{"DisableTelemetry":true}}}. Response example: 200 {"ok":true}. Error examples: 400, 404, 422, or 503.

step.cmd: Export the canonical Firefox policies document.

info.p: Request example: GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/export/profiles/42/firefox/policies.json?download=1&pretty=1. Response example: 200 application/json with Content-Disposition and top-level policies. Compliance metadata are not exported.

step.cmd: Write the handoff record before downstream deployment.

info.note: Store source hash, profile ID, revision, validation response, export hash, scanner result, reviewer, and downstream owner outside BPM. Do not treat BPM export as proof that Firefox has applied the policy.

result.p: The external product receives a canonical Firefox deployment document and a separate compliance handoff record with clear ownership boundaries.

postreq.p: Use deployment tooling outside BPM to place the exported policies.json on managed Firefox systems.
